requests.prompt: A cheerful middle-aged tea stall woman, round and sturdy, hair tied up with a cloth, apron over work clothes, sleeves rolled up, holding out a steaming clay teapot in offering, broad warm smile, steam rising from the pot. Chinese ink-wash xianxia portrait painting, classic sumi-e style. A pale rice-paper background in warm off-white (#f2ecdd) with subtle ink wash gradients, faint ink mountains and mist far behind. The figure is drawn with confident black ink brushwork, robes rendered in soft grey washes with fine brush texture, and the key contours picked out with a single thin antique-gold line. Muted desaturated palette, warm paper tones, ink black, one gold accent only. Head-and-shoulders three-quarter framing, figure centered, clean empty space around the head. Painterly, restrained, no text, no characters, no watermark, no logo, no border, no dark background.
